newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Monberg & Thorsen 1996 earnings up.
newsitem.headline: Danish Monberg & Thorsen 1996 earnings up.

text.p: of group profit after tax 130 vs 124

NOTE - Full name of Danish construction group is Monberg & Thorsen Holding A/S, whole owner of Monberg & Thorsen A/S, which has a 24 percent stake in MT Group, the international consortium which constructed the twin rail tunnels under Denmark's Great Belt Waterway which opened for goods traffic on April 6.

The tunnel project is part of the fixed road/rail, tunnel/bridge link joining Zealand island, site of Copenhagen, with the European mainland via Funen island, a project due for final completion by mid-1998. The firm said in a statement that it expected the holding company's share of group profits to be similar in 1997 to this year's 130 million crowns.
